_doc: Campaign-independent images made ahead of play by `assets.py seed`. Each set maps a slug to an entry; the slug must equal the key slug of `name` (Langschwert → langschwert). `prompt` is the English subject description (the shared style from image-provider.json is appended). `aliases` also resolve to the entry (e.g. SRD names for English campaigns); `srd` names the SRD record the entry stands for. Override in <data-root>/config/asset-seed.json: add entries by slug, remove one with null.
